gloss: entirely; completely; in bulk; all at once

definitions.gloss: entirely, completely, in bulk, all at once
definitions.explanation: Describes a large quantity being taken, removed, or disappearing at once. Often implies surprise or emphasis on the amount.

examples.japanese: お{金|かね}がごっそり{消|き}えた。
{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}の{中身|なかみ}がごっそりなくなっていた。
examples.english: The contents of the fridge were completely gone.

examples.japanese: {泥棒|どろぼう}に{貴重品|きちょうひん}をごっそり{持|も}っていかれた。
examples.english: The thief made off with all the valuables.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ごっそり{持|も}っていく: to take everything away
- ごっそり{抜|ぬ}ける: to fall out in clumps (hair)
- ごっそりなくなる: to disappear completely
- ごっそり{盗|ぬす}まれる: to have everything stolen

USAGE: Emphasizes that a large amount was affected all at once. Often used when describing loss, theft, or removal. Has an onomatopoeic quality suggesting bulk removal.
